faqs.a:
Section 308.5. Residential areas,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
308.5. Residential areas.
No rubbish or garbage containers shall be stored in front of a residence, whether
                  single-family or multiple-family, or in front of the residential building line closest
                  to an adjacent street. Such containers shall be placed as close to curbside as possible
                  without obstructing the sidewalk or street in front of a single-family dwelling or
                  multiple-family dwelling for collection purposes, for a period not to exceed 24 consecutive
                  hours once each week."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
